lastCompletedStory.title: Variadic composite promote in one atomic on-main commit

nextStoryContext: promoteSuggestionOnMain's options field is now `fingerprints: string[]` (was `fingerprint: string`); result is `{ ok: true, fingerprints, issueId, sha }`. All fingerprints are validated against the pen BEFORE writeIssueFile is ever invoked (loop returns not-found on first miss), so all-or-nothing falls out for free -- no explicit rollback needed. buildPromotedDescription/buildPromotedTitle special-case entries.length===1 internally to stay byte-identical to the pre-US-001 single-fp shape; the commit message unconditionally joins fingerprints with '+' (degenerates to the bare fingerprint for a 1-element list). dispatchSuggestions' promoteFn/CAM_SUGGESTIONS_PROMOTED stdout line now also joins fingerprints with '+'. parseSuggestionsArgs' promote branch is now variadic (>=1 fingerprint, no upper bound); dismiss stays single-fp only. Any future story touching the pen's terminal-verdict auto-file path (CAM-189) or suggestion-followups.ts should be aware promote can now file one issue for N pen entries.
